text:
inc_bot: realtime detector: p99 latency regression in eu-streaming-api detected
inc_bot: metric=p99 value=1.94s baseline=0.41s p95=0.50s window=5m rule=auto-threshold
oncall-anna: paging @sre_roberto @devin_runtime @mike_sre — seeing p99 ~2s for streaming. oncall taking lead.
oncall-anna: any recent deploys or config flips?
sre_roberto: no deploys in last 45m. checking node metrics, GC, and recent error spikes.
ops_ben: observing increase in stalled stream writes and consumer timeouts in eu-west cluster. some 502/504s to clients.
devin_runtime: kvcache miss rate spiked, evictions up x6. prefix cache churn looks correlated.
devin_runtime: sample log: ```
[stream] write took=1832ms backend_write=1600ms kv_hit=false prefix=abc123
```
mike_sre: LB and CDN show normal health. autoscaler touched unrelated service ~20m ago.
lisa_prod: no infra changes for streaming service.
james_csm: ACME support reported slow streams and reconnects ~12m ago (customer eu-west).
oncall-anna: impact = customer-facing. mitigation plan: 1) divert portion of streaming traffic to fallback model variant; 2) increase kvcache TTL on canaries; 3) toggle LRU-only on hot nodes. execute and report.
devin_runtime: bumping kvcache TTL from 5s -> 30s on two canary nodes now.
ops_ben: initiating route shift: 25% -> fallback variant (stateless) for eu shards.
sre_roberto: collecting heap/pprof on streamer workers, checking goroutine growth.
mike_sre: requesting infra to snapshot memory usage and block profiles.
devin_runtime: also reducing client retry aggressiveness to avoid amplifying stalls.
ops_ben: route-shift active. initial p99 down to ~1.3s. p95 stable.
devin_runtime: canary kvcache hit climbed to 0.87 after TTL bump. p99 trending down.
sre_roberto: found goroutine leak pattern in streamer.WriteLoop tied to stalled client sessions; uploading profiles to s3://redwood/incident/5943211111/heapshots/
mike_sre: can we flip eviction policy to LRU-only on affected nodes until we patch? might reduce churn.
devin_runtime: enabling LRU-only on two problematic hosts now.
oncall-anna: CS note draft for ACME: "We detected a transient latency regression impacting streaming sessions in EU. We've diverted some traffic and adjusted cache TTLs; engineers are investigating root cause. Expect partial recovery within 15-30m. We'll follow up with a timeline and postmortem." :thumbsup:
ops_ben: monitoring: p99=0.65s, p95=0.48s after mitigations.
james_csm: ACME confirms improvement and fewer reconnects.
oncall-anna: creating incident ticket. assigning ENG-RUNTIME for root-cause (goroutine leak), SRE for node remediation, CS for customer updates.
inc_bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-5943211111 | severity=high | owner=oncall-anna
devin_runtime: opening PR to revert kvcache experiment (refs #5147) and add prefix-churn metrics.
sre_roberto: will keep monitoring and request node recycle if memory pressure returns.
oncall-anna: follow-up runbook: if p99 > 1.5s for >10m re-escalate to eng-runtime secondary on-call.
ops_ben: leaving live mitigation window; final quick check shows p99=0.56s, p95=0.46s. moving incident to retrospective.
oncall-anna: incident window ~20m, mitigations worked, assigning postmortem owners. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
